decisions.rationale: Idiopathic hypertrophic pachymeningitis does not match the clinical presentation and laboratory findings.
Granulomatous Meningoencephalitis of Unknown Etiology does not match the clinical presentation and laboratory findings.
Chronic meningitis does not match the clinical presentation and laboratory findings, and special stains were negative for infectious causes.
